findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_coa_requirements, get_municipal_health_guidelines, get_food_handler_training_standards, calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness · Private data: check_coa_requirements, get_municipal_health_guidelines, get_food_handler_training_standards, calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness, request_compliance_audit · Public sink: request_compliance_audit · Destructive: check_coa_requirements, get_municipal_health_guidelines, get_food_handler_training_standards, calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness, request_compliance_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_coa_requirements, get_municipal_health_guidelines, get_food_handler_training_standards, calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness · Private data: check_coa_requirements, get_municipal_health_guidelines, get_food_handler_training_standards, calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness, request_compliance_audit · Public sink: request_compliance_audit · Destructive: check_coa_requirements, get_municipal_health_guidelines, get_food_handler_training_standards, calculate_facility_hygiene_readiness, request_compliance_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
